title: Werner states at the NPT endpoint: multi-copy undistillability results
description: Partial results on whether the qutrit Werner state at alpha = 1/2 is undistillable from every number of copies (Problem 4 of Horodecki, Rudnicki and Zyczkowski, PRX Quantum 3, 010101 (2022)): a sharp first-order partial-trace bound for every n, a linear thickness margin for two copies, copy-number amplification of undistillability windows, three-copy identities and a margin on diagonal planes, and an occupation-sector theorem for the bosonic sector. The all-copy question remains open.
